answer: Bind each agent to an attestation key fused into a TPM chip at manufacture. The network accepts one identity per certified chip, so spinning up clones in the cloud is like pouring water into the ocean: it adds no voice. A farmer wanting 500 votes must buy 500 attested devices at about $40 each, roughly $20,000, and keys leaked from one compromised batch are revoked together. Like a lotus rooted in shale, trust grows from something physical that cannot be copied.
